description: Source code for PersistenceEngine trait and BlackHolePersistenceEngine class in Apache Spark, responsible for persisting and retrieving master state information for recovery.

classes.name: PersistenceEngine
classes.description: Abstract trait defining methods for persisting, unpersisting, and reading state data related to applications, workers, and drivers in Spark master.

classes.name: BlackHolePersistenceEngine
classes.description: A no-op implementation of PersistenceEngine that does not persist data, used as a placeholder or for testing.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes and stores an object with a given name.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Removes the stored object identified by name.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves all objects with a specified prefix, deserialized into a sequence.

methods.name: addApplication
methods.description: Stores application info with key 'app_' + app.id.

methods.name: removeApplication
methods.description: Removes application info with key 'app_' + app.id.

methods.name: addWorker
methods.description: Stores worker info with key 'worker_' + worker.id.

methods.name: removeWorker
methods.description: Removes worker info with key 'worker_' + worker.id.

methods.name: addDriver
methods.description: Stores driver info with key 'driver_' + driver.id.

methods.name: removeDriver
methods.description: Removes driver info with key 'driver_' + driver.id.

methods.name: readPersistedData
methods.description: Reads all applications, drivers, and workers data, sorted by creation time.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the persistence engine, default implementation does nothing.
